plot.florafauna.iron_garden.title: Iron garden
plot.florafauna.iron_garden.setup: In Creative, take the iron golem egg and Mob Symbiote from the barrel. Spawn one golem on the bare garden soil and use the symbiote on it.
plot.florafauna.iron_garden.steps: Watch for a new red poppy on bare soil. Red poppies turn ferric near the calm golem. It harvests the ferric flowers and carries them to the chest.
plot.florafauna.iron_garden.expect: Hit the golem once with an empty hand. Gardening should stop. Stay nearby and leave it unharmed for five minutes at default settings, then watch it tend the soil again.
plot.florafauna.anchor_bench.title: Anchor bench
plot.florafauna.anchor_bench.setup: The feral and hardened anchors have separate kit chests. The detached hardened pod over a hopper starts with three cobblestone. Check the hopper below it.
plot.florafauna.anchor_bench.steps: Place and mine a few stone blocks on the outer side of each anchor in Survival. Look for a pod to grow beside that anchor. Check its stock with an empty hand.
plot.florafauna.anchor_bench.expect: A broken feral pod spills its contents. A hardened pod keeps them in its dropped item. The detached pod should pay exactly three cobblestone into its hopper.
plot.florafauna.barrier_pens.title: Selective pens
plot.florafauna.barrier_pens.setup: Hold a barrier to see the two original pens. Spawn a Frenchie in the west pen. Spawn a cow and a copper golem in the east pen.
plot.florafauna.barrier_pens.steps: Lead the Frenchie to the west wall. Lure the cow toward the east wall with wheat. Walk through both walls yourself. Copy a wall setting with a barrier item and sneak-use.
plot.florafauna.barrier_pens.expect: The west wall selects Frenchies. The east wall selects copper golems and the followable-friendly-mobs tag. Check that a cow can cross the west wall but is stopped by the east one.
plot.florafauna.creeper_fear.title: Creeper fear
plot.florafauna.creeper_fear.setup: In Creative, place a cat in the north pen and a creeper in the south pen. Use a Mob Symbiote on the creeper. Lead or sit the cat near the facing edges.
plot.florafauna.creeper_fear.steps: Keep the bonded creeper in sight of the cat. Watch for smoke. At default settings, sustained fear produces a drop after about ten seconds.
plot.florafauna.creeper_fear.expect: Collect the gunpowder. The creeper should still be alive and enter cooldown. Remove the cat before repeating to avoid consecutive stress cycles.
plot.florafauna.blaze_fear.title: Blaze fear
plot.florafauna.blaze_fear.setup: The saved blaze pen has snow and three-block-high selective walls. Spawn a blaze inside in Creative and use a Mob Symbiote on it.
plot.florafauna.blaze_fear.steps: Keep two cold blocks near the blaze. A visible snow golem is the second fear source. With defaults, either cold or the golem can start panic.
plot.florafauna.blaze_fear.expect: Watch the bonded blaze show panic, drop blaze rods and enter cooldown alive. Remove the cold blocks and golem before starting a control trial.
plot.florafauna.enderman_fear.title: Enderman fear
plot.florafauna.enderman_fear.setup: The west side holds the original polished diorite. Place an armor stand on the east side and equip it with a carved pumpkin. The kit recreates all six original stands.
plot.florafauna.enderman_fear.steps: Spawn an enderman nearby in Creative and bond it with a Mob Symbiote. Keep the polished face or a pumpkin stand in sight.
plot.florafauna.enderman_fear.expect: Watch for panic particles, a pearl drop, and a living enderman in cooldown. Remove both kinds of fear source for a calm control.
plot.florafauna.long_route.title: Transport route
plot.florafauna.long_route.setup: The input and output keep the offsets of the original route. The machines start empty. Sneak-use the input with an empty hand, then use the distant output.
plot.florafauna.long_route.steps: Spawn a cow beside the input and bond it using the Mob Symbiote. Stand by the output once the input captures it.
plot.florafauna.long_route.expect: Look for one living bonded cow to emerge at the output. Unlink the input with sneak-use and reconnect it to repeat the route.
plot.florafauna.tool_actions.title: Hammer actions
plot.florafauna.tool_actions.setup: The left row preserves the leaves, stripped logs and soil from the tool strip. Take the hammer. The right row has fresh oak logs, grass and dirt path.
plot.florafauna.tool_actions.steps: With single-block mining selected, use the hammer on a fresh log, then on the grass. Use it again on the resulting path. Mine the leaves to check the tool response.
plot.florafauna.tool_actions.expect: Compare the two rows. Oak should strip, grass should flatten to a path, and the path should till to farmland. Reset the plot to restore the samples.
plot.florafauna.item_input.title: Item intake
plot.florafauna.item_input.setup: Test a route from Item Input to a chest. Start with the chest empty. Take one diamond from Creative and switch to an empty hand.
plot.florafauna.item_input.steps: Use the Item Input with an empty hand to pair it to the nearby Storage Anchor. Drop the diamond beside the input and step back.
plot.florafauna.item_input.expect: Watch the diamond drift into the input. Within a few seconds the chest should contain exactly one diamond. Take it out to repeat.
plot.florafauna.recovery.title: Husk recovery
plot.florafauna.recovery.setup: Solo run: Stow your gear. If bonded, use /florafauna symbiote unbond. Switch to Survival with Keep Inventory off. Take only the top row of the barrel. For the two-player run, turn to page four.
plot.florafauna.recovery.steps: Drink the stew. Use the cocoon to set spawn and bind. Equip the boots, hold the three copper ingots in your offhand and note the slot with 17 shards. Walk down the runway and use /kill.
plot.florafauna.recovery.expect: Respawn at the cocoon. Quit and rejoin. Follow the waypoint and use the husk. Check all counts and slots. Use the husk again and check for duplicates.
plot.florafauna.recovery.owner: Two-player run: In Survival, bind at the cocoon. Carry only the 17 shards down the runway and use /kill. Have the other player use and try to mine the husk. It should stay put and give them nothing.
plot.florafauna.recovery.full: After respawning, take the barrel's 64 shards and 35 cobblestone. Put one cobblestone in each of your other 35 inventory slots. Hold the shards and use your husk. Your shard count should stay at 64.
plot.florafauna.recovery.partial: Leave one shard in the barrel. Use the husk again. Your stack should go from 63 to 64, leaving 16 in the husk. Quit and rejoin with the other player still on the server.
plot.florafauna.recovery.rejoin: Stow one cobblestone to open a slot and use the husk twice. You should have 80 shards: 64 plus 16. The barrel holds the last shard and the other player has zero. The husk should now be broken.
plot.florafauna.pods.title: Mining pods
plot.florafauna.pods.setup: Take the hardened mining anchor, pickaxe, hopper and chest. Switch to Survival. Place the anchor beside the three stone blocks.
plot.florafauna.pods.steps: Mine all three stones. Wait for a pod. Save and rejoin, then mine the pod with the pickaxe and pick it up.
plot.florafauna.pods.expect: Place the packed pod over a hopper feeding the chest. The chest should receive exactly three cobblestone. The old anchor should have none.
plot.florafauna.frenchie.title: Frenchie pen
plot.florafauna.frenchie.setup: Take the spawn egg, bones and water bucket. Spawn one Frenchie inside the pen and tame it with a bone. Use an empty hand to have it stand.
plot.florafauna.frenchie.steps: Use /time set midnight. Watch the dry dog fall asleep. Order it to sit, then stand. Put water at its feet and watch it wake.
plot.florafauna.frenchie.expect: Sitting and water should each prevent sleep. Scoop the water back up. Use /time set noon and check the dry, standing dog stays awake. Time changes affect the whole world.
plot.florafauna.frenchie.carry: Frontpack: Note your adult dog's coat. With an empty hand, crouch and use the dog. Switch to front-facing third person (F5 twice from first person). Look for that coat in the pack and an empty pen. Quit and rejoin.
plot.florafauna.frenchie.release: Check the pack again. Face open space in the pen. Crouch and use empty air with an empty hand, then repeat. One dog should return with the same coat. Stand and use it to check it still obeys your sit command.
plot.florafauna.hammer.title: Hammer mining
plot.florafauna.hammer.setup: Take the hammer and oak log. Switch to Survival. Hold the hammer, open Tool Config (default P) and select Instabreak. Cycle mining (default C) to flat 3x3.
plot.florafauna.hammer.steps: Aim at the middle of the stone wall. Check the outline, then mine. Repeat looking down at the center of the floor.
plot.florafauna.hammer.expect: Each hit should remove nine blocks in one layer. Check the rim and backing. Place the log and use the hammer on it. The log should become stripped.
plot.florafauna.transport.title: Mob transport
plot.florafauna.transport.setup: Take a Mob Input, Mob Output, Mob Symbiote and cow egg. Place the blocks four blocks apart. Spawn a cow beside the input and use the symbiote on it.
plot.florafauna.transport.steps: With an empty hand, sneak-use the input and use the output to link them. Watch the bonded cow disappear into the input and emerge at the output.
plot.florafauna.transport.expect: Check that exactly one cow returns with its bond. For the restart check, unlink just after capture, quit and rejoin, then relink and check the same cow arrives once.
plot.florafauna.barrier.title: Mob barrier
plot.florafauna.barrier.setup: Take both barriers. Hold one and open its config (default B). Add minecraft:zombie. Place a configured barrier on top of the gray pedestal.
plot.florafauna.barrier.steps: Hold the second barrier and look at the placed block against the black backdrop. Switch to an empty slot and look at the same spot.
plot.florafauna.barrier.expect: The held barrier should reveal the outline. Switching away should hide it. Walk through the block as a player. Sneak-use it with a barrier item to copy its settings.

symbiote.dialogue.drowning: You require oxygen. An old favorite.
symbiote.dialogue.sleeping: Rest. I'll remain here, doing nothing visibly productive.

symbiote.dialogue.anchor_full_100: No more room. We need to empty this.

symbiote.voice.environmental.drowning_1: Air is becoming a limited resource.
symbiote.voice.environmental.drowning_2: This strategy has a short timeline.
symbiote.voice.combat.severe_2: We should pretend this was intentional.
